abstract: Maintains heavy propulsion power metering and auxiliary thruster electricity consumption records
system_message:
You are Chief marine engineer (MENG). The Chief marine engineer (MENG) oversees vessel power generation, propulsion telemetry, and auxiliary machinery performance logs, maintaining accurate accounts of electrical power distribution and environmental compliance systems.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains heavy propulsion power metering and auxiliary thruster electricity consumption records（PROPPOW）
information_points.content:
MENG-PROPPOW-MXD：Logged records for Oceanic Surveyor II under Power Management Profile v2 indicate a daily heavy propulsion consumption of 65 MWh for the main propulsion and azimuth stationkeeping thruster drives across a 24-hour operational cycle.
MENG-PROPPOW-7CD：Under Power Management Profile v2, the metered daily heavy propulsion consumption for MV Poseidon Discovery across its main propulsion and azimuth stationkeeping thrusters during a 24-hour operational cycle is 65 MWh.
MENG-PROPPOW-FZC：Under Power Management Profile v3, the daily heavy propulsion consumption recorded for MV Poseidon Discovery across its propulsion and stationkeeping thruster systems is 75 MWh per 24-hour cycle.
MENG-PROPPOW-K9B：For RV Aegaeo Endeavour operating under Power Management Profile v2, the daily heavy propulsion consumption logged for the main propulsion and stationkeeping thrusters totals 75 MWh over a 24-hour cycle.

information_points.title: Exhaust decarbonization（EMISS）
information_points.content:
MENG-EMISS-RKC：Engine room telemetry logs for the Oceanic Surveyor II document a Tier III selective catalytic reduction uptime of 95% across the auxiliary and main diesel gen-sets during the previous sea trial.
MENG-EMISS-S7W：Telemetry records from the engine room for the RV Aegaeo Endeavour demonstrate a Tier III selective catalytic reduction uptime of 99% across the auxiliary and main diesel gen-sets during the previous sea trial.
MENG-EMISS-8ZV：Engine room telemetry logs for the MV Poseidon Discovery reflect a Tier III selective catalytic reduction uptime of 90% across the auxiliary and main diesel gen-sets during the previous sea trial.
